title: NOAA NGS GRAV-D airborne gravity, block EN02 (main data lines)

radius_enters_via.how: NOAA removed the Eötvös effect with the GRS80 radii; putting it back needs those radii
velocities from the published positions on the GRS80 ellipsoid (computed by fog)

verdict_rule: Uncorrected airborne gravity that agrees between eastbound and westbound lines, or a best fraction of the globe's Eötvös correction of 0 rather than 1.

sources.cite: NOAA National Geodetic Survey, GRAV-D (Gravity for the Redefinition of the American Vertical Datum), Block EN02 release BETA2

units.t: s of day (UTC) in the release, 1 Hz
units.g: mGal, full-field gravity at altitude, Eötvös-corrected by NGS, not leveled

inputs.origin: NOAA NGS GRAV-D, Block EN02 release BETA2.

notes: One block = one input zip; adding a block is one more input line with its URL, then fog fetch, fog lock, fog build. Only the main data file of each zip is read (not the supplement: cross lines and transits).
